newsitem.title: USA: North American Mortgage valued - report.
newsitem.headline: North American Mortgage valued - report.

text.p: Analysts value North American Mortgage Corp at $20 to $30 a share, Business Week said.
North American Mortgage stock closed at 20-7/8 Thursday.
According to the report, Gary Gorden of Paine Webber said the company's book value plus the value of its loan-servicing portfolio was about $20 a share.
Gorden said the company's mortgage-lending business was worth $3 to $5 a share and its alliance with ContiFinancial Corp could add up to $3 a share in value.
Gareth Plank of UBS Securities said the ContiFinancial alliance could add $0.75 a share to his estimated 1997 earnings of $2.70 a share, Business Week said.
The company earned $2.69 a share in 1995.
